artifactAvailability: Raw scripts, reviews, runtime, snapshots, logs and retained trajectories are ignored local research evidence. This ledger binds them but does not provision them in a fresh clone.

definition.collisionSet: area-weighted IPC source contributions; exact finite-feature construction

featureSelection.activation: Exact d2 < captured RN(dmin*dmin) + captured RN((2*dmin+dhat)*dhat).
featureSelection.coefficients: Native binary64 rest areas and IPC source-role factors; retain one contribution per active source candidate, without merging coefficients.
featureSelection.derivatives: Native forced-feature derivatives; finite/positive checks are not an arithmetic-error certificate.
featureSelection.geometry: Exact finite-primitive distances on binary64 coordinates; no angular cutoff.
featureSelection.minimum: Exact d2 > captured RN(dmin*dmin); native finite positive separation also required.
featureSelection.mollifier: Captured native rest threshold; retain EE when exact current cross-norm squared is below it.
featureSelection.order: VV, EV, EE, FV; each ordered by primitive identities, feature, mollifier threshold and captured coefficient.
featureSelection.restScale: Exact closest rest d2; RN(sqrt(RN(d2)))/4; reject unrepresentable squares or scales.
featureSelection.scope: Supplied candidate inventory only. Broad-phase completeness, path safety and physical accuracy require separate verification.
featureSelection.ties: Lower feature dimension, then native enum order.

definition.inputConversion: Inherited adapter conversion to binary64 precedes exact geometry; no exactness claim for pre-conversion inputs. Bounded work separately requires raw binary64 endpoints.
limitations: Changed contact model, not a tolerance fix or paper reproduction.
Local positive core and activation derive from each primitive pair's own rest distance.
Planar connected rest components only; no sewing or layer operations.
Closest-feature transitions are not globally C2; Hessians use the selected piecewise stencil.
No refinement-convergent quadrature, global thickness guarantee or garment acceptance.
Native broad-phase allocation and CCD require external process budgets.
Native areas, primitive derivatives and barrier arithmetic remain numerical inputs.
definition.localScaleRule: exact rest d2, RN(sqrt(RN(d2)))/4; minimum=min(full minimum, activation)

implementation: Exact candidate classification and scalar-clamp activation before native construction.
Forced finite features, retained mollifiers and one unmerged coefficient per active source candidate.
Per-pair exact rest filtering and enclosing broad-phase radius, with native arithmetic limitations.
Optional rest-filtered profile, complete native endpoint work and immutable model identity.
Derived diagnostic cache excluded from problem identity; physical configuration remains bound.

regression.failureResolution: Six reported failures in existing motion integration exposed diagnostic cache population changing problem identity. Exclude only this derived cache; avoid creating it in the legacy route. Existing failures and new exact-profile identity/motion regressions pass.

remaining: Prospective temporal study must explicitly name this changed contact model.
Original adaptive A/B failures, B energy/depth feasibility and 1024/2048 reference disagreement are not retroactively repaired.
Original preload, released tail, temporal/spatial accuracy and finite native derivative error remain unverified.
Calibrated material/body evidence, complete shirt acceptance and assembled application integration.

result.scope: All retained old-model endpoints plus initial state evaluated under the explicitly changed exact-feature contact model. Independent finite-primitive minima and activation over all supplied native candidates; complete capture and finite native E/g/H. No solve, new trajectory, native broad-phase completeness proof, derivative error bound, path proof or temporal/physical acceptance.

retainedCoverage.scope: Primary adaptation of an independently authored finite-geometry oracle. Independently checks supplied-candidate minima/activation, per-bucket active counts and each captured term feature. No native broad-phase completeness claim.

review.boundedBuilder: Independent exact minima, unmerged source role weights and multiplicity, native E/g/H component sums and extreme derivative rejection.
review.cacheIdentity: Ordinary assignments reject; forced model-definition/radius/parameter changes alter identity; only the derived cache is excluded.

scope: All2049 original retained endpoint identities and exact fractions verified. Complete expected ContactTerm multisets reconstructed from source candidate IDs/topology, independent Fraction closest-feature oracle and explicit tie/conversion rules; source-role weights and mollifier thresholds are trusted captured native mesh coefficients. Every field, float representation and duplicate multiplicity compared canonically.

Oracle does not import production classifier or builder functions. Actual captures necessarily use the production adapter. Fixture construction and independent mathematical helper are explicitly reused and identity-bound.

Native broad-phase completeness, cache coefficient/source authenticity, gradient/Hessian arithmetic error, contact paths, solved motion under the new model, temporal accuracy and physical calibration are not certified. No solves or trajectories executed.

review.defaultCompatibility: Six static rotated/parallel states reproduce legacy default profile and E/g/H bytes.
